mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year change in CPIAUCSL exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation requiring monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY change > 2.5%, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in labor force participation (PAYEMS) and housing starts (HOUST) signals economic weakening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of PAYEMS and HOUST does not produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both series decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where the federal funds rate is below 1.0% and CPIAUCSL YoY change is below 2.0%, constrained monetary policy leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: low rate and low inflation regime
failure_condition: In the regime defined by FEDFUNDS < 1.0 and CPIAUCSL YoY change < 2.0%, SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Rising unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals deteriorating labor market conditions, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 550.0 (thousands of units), it signals housing market contraction, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in < 40% of instances where HOUST < 550.0, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and residential sales (RSAFS) signals economic weakening, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction of INDPRO and RSAFS does not produce negative 60d returns in > 60% of instances where both series decline, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In regimes where real GDP growth (GDPC1) is below 1.0% annualized and housing starts (HOUST) are below 550.0, accommodative monetary policy drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0% AND HOUST < 550.0
failure_condition: In the regime defined by GDPC1 annualized growth rate < 1.0% and HOUST < 550.0, SPX produces positive 20d returns in < 40% of instances, or the Rank IC over 3 years is < 0.03.
